import os,re,json

def load():

def fillcheck(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    out=[]
    for c in enc2(g):
        rs=[i for i,j in c]; cs_=[j for i,j in c]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs_),max(cs_)
        hgt=r1-r0+1; wid=c1-c0+1
        ws=sum(1 for i,j in c for di,dj in D4 if 0<=i+di<len(g) and 0<=j+dj<len(g[0]) and g[i+di][j+dj]!=bg)/len(c)
        box={(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)}
        wallcells=[g[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if (i,j) not in c]
        distinct=set(wallcells)
        out.append((len(c),'F' if hgt*wid-len(c)==0 else 'M'))  # placeholder
        out[-1]=((len(c),hgt,wid,round(ws,2)), len(c)<hgt*wid, wallcells.count(max(wallcells,key=wallcells.count))>sum(wallcells.count(v) for v in set(wallcells)))
    return out

def solveJ(g,keep_min_ws=True):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    E=enc2(g)
    info=[]
    for c in E:
        ws=sum(1 for i,j in c for di,dj in D4 if 0<=i+di<len(g) and 0<=j+dj<len(g[0]) and g[i+di][j+dj]!=g[0][0])/len(c)
        info.append((c,ws))
    pick=min(info,key=lambda x:x[1]) if keep_min_ws else max(info,key=lambda x:x[1])
    for c,ws in info:
        if c!=pick[0]:
            for i,j in c: g[i][j]=4
    return g
allok=all(solveJ(G[p+' input'])==G[p+' output'] for p in ('Demo pair %d'%n for n in range(1,6)))
